description: This file is a CMake script defining a function 'map_issubsetof' that checks if one map (subset) is contained within another map (superset). It performs recursive checks on nested maps and lists, returning true if all entries of the subset are contained within the superset.

methods.name: map_issubsetof
methods.description: A function that determines if one map (subset) is a subset of another map (superset), handling nested maps and lists recursively.
